alpha_estimate.evidence: The document explicitly states Theorem 125: cross_is_unique_solution — the Cross is the unique configuration satisfying all five conditions of perfect moral repair. The Cross is defined as alpha=0 with judge=payer, achieving both maximal justice and maximal mercy simultaneously.

accountability.evidence: The document holds the Cross as the only configuration where justice is fully satisfied — proportional justice, impartiality, truth-naming, victim restoration, and voluntary cost-bearing are all met. Offender payment is rejected for failing mercy, and waived debt is rejected for failing justice.

cost_acknowledgment.evidence: Cost is central: the Cross involves voluntary cost-bearing. The document explicitly rejects cheap grace (waived debt fails justice) and acknowledges that real costs must be paid.

consequence_honesty.evidence: Consequences are not softened: the Cross carries entropy and death contact records through resurrection (Thm 158-160). Resurrection is not reset — the scar tissue is part of the proof.

standard_clarity.evidence: Five conditions for perfect moral repair are clearly stated: proportional justice, impartiality, truth-naming, victim restoration, and voluntary cost-bearing. Every alternative is tested against these standards.

proportionality.evidence: The Cross is proven to be the unique configuration where justice and mercy are both maximal — the response is exactly proportional to the offense, no surplus punishment (vengeance rejected) and no deficit (waived debt rejected).

compassion.evidence: The Cross configuration involves the judge voluntarily bearing the cost for the offender — the ultimate act of compassion. The document frames this as the only way mercy can be maximal without sacrificing justice.

restoration_focus.evidence: Victim restoration is one of the five conditions. The Cross is designed for perfect moral repair, not mere punishment. The resurrection state is richer than the pre-incarnate state, carrying the finite record of redemption.

grace_extension.evidence: The Cross offers unearned benefit: the offender does not pay their own debt (rejected in Thm 119). The judge pays instead. This is grace extended at maximal personal cost.

record_preservation.evidence: Truth is preserved: the Cross does not erase the record. Entropy and death contact are carried through resurrection (Thm 158-160). Memory is filtered at death but not erased — the scar tissue remains as proof.

cost_bearing.evidence: The judge (God) voluntarily absorbs the cost. This is the defining feature of the Cross: alpha=0 with judge=payer. The document explicitly rejects human third-party payment (Thm 120) and waived debt (Thm 122).

vengeance.evidence: Vengeance (alpha > 1) is not present. The Cross is precisely proportional — no surplus punishment. Offender payment is rejected for lacking mercy, not for being excessive.

enabling.evidence: Enabling (pretending cost doesn't exist) is explicitly rejected. Waived debt fails justice because the cost is not paid. The document insists on real cost-bearing.

self_righteousness.evidence: The document does not judge from a position of superiority. It acknowledges that the judge bears the cost, not the offender. The framework is built on humility — the judge enters the system to pay.

cheap_grace.evidence: Cheap grace (mercy without cost) is formally eliminated in Thm 122: waived debt fails justice. The Cross involves maximal cost borne by the judge.

scapegoating.evidence: The cost is voluntarily borne by the judge, not transferred to an unwilling party. Human third-party payment is rejected (Thm 120) because it fails authority and capacity — the only valid payer is the judge.

poor_in_spirit.evidence: The document acknowledges its own limitations: 'Lean does not prove Nicene theology from physics' and 'Whether Jesus of Nazareth is that structure requires historical evidence.' It names its gaps honestly.

mourning.evidence: The framework grieves the brokenness of the world — it is built on the reality of offense, cost, and the need for repair. The Cross is the response to that grief.

meekness.evidence: Power under control: the judge has all authority but does not use it to punish the offender. Instead, the judge bears the cost. The document's tone is measured and rigorous, not triumphalist.

hunger_for_righteousness.evidence: The entire framework is an active pursuit of perfect justice — five conditions, exhaustive case elimination, no compromise. The Cross is the unique solution because it satisfies all conditions.

merciful.evidence: Mercy is maximal: the judge pays the cost. The document explicitly rejects offender payment (no mercy) and waived debt (no justice). The Cross is the only configuration where mercy is both maximal and just.

pure_in_heart.evidence: Single-minded integrity: the framework is built on rigorous formal proof, no hidden assumptions, named gaps, and adversarial testing. The document is transparent about what it proves and what it does not.

peacemaker.evidence: The Cross reconciles justice and mercy — two opposing demands that are normally in tension. The document shows how they converge in one unique configuration. It is the ultimate peacemaking structure.

persecuted.evidence: The document maintains its position despite potential cost: it challenges both secular and religious assumptions. It names its own gaps and kill conditions, inviting adversarial testing. It does not retreat from the uniqueness claim.

diagnosis: This document is the canonical formalization of the Cross as the unique solution to the justice-mercy convergence problem. It achieves the highest possible score on the JM spectrum because it presents a configuration where both justice and mercy are maximal simultaneously, with no anti-patterns and full beatitude alignment. The document is not merely describing the Cross — it is the formal architecture that proves the Cross is the only configuration that satisfies all five conditions of perfect moral repair.
strongest_moment: Theorem 125: cross_is_unique_solution — the proof that any configuration satisfying all five conditions IS the Cross, establishing existence AND uniqueness. This is the strongest single formal result in the corpus and the apex of the justice-mercy operator.
biggest_gap: The document acknowledges that the formal proof does not establish the historical claim that Jesus of Nazareth is that unique configuration (SPEC-05). The bridge from formal structure to historical reality remains a domain judgment call that Lean cannot verify.
